mentions.note: 6th Commonwealth Games javelin; club record 58.20m winning AAA U23

photos.c: Centre left: Goldie Sayes is pictured competing in the Commonwealth Games where she placed 6th. She set a new club mark of 58.20m for the javelin when winning the AAA U23 Championships and was another winner in the Cup Final.
